name: Button
structurePatterns: horizontal flex with 8px gap; label single-line; centered content
shape is independent: standard uses radius-control; pill uses radius-pill without changing 40/48px visual height
hierarchy (Primary/Secondary/Tertiary), semantic intent (default/destructive), shape (standard/pill), size, and state are separate axes
loading defaults to spinner + label; spinner-only is allowed only with an accessible name
loading state locks the entering control dimensions and suppresses repeat activation
full-width in mobile forms (.block modifier stretches to 100%)
icon-only or spinner-only buttons keep square visual geometry and the platform minimum hit target
usageHints: Primary is a scarce hierarchy signal: normally one highest-priority primary action per view or action group
Do not promote every available action to Primary; use Secondary for visible supporting actions and Tertiary for low-emphasis actions
When Primary and supporting actions appear together, avoid multiple brand-filled buttons competing in the same visual region
Destructive is a semantic intent, not a replacement for Primary/Secondary/Tertiary hierarchy
Use destructive only for destructive or irreversible actions; do not add Success/Warning button semantics without real usage evidence
Pill is a deliberate shape variant for compact action affordances, not a license to make every button capsule-shaped
Loading blocks duplicate activation, keeps dimensions stable, exposes busy semantics, and remains distinct from disabled
Visual height differs from platform hit target (iOS 44 / Android 48)
doNotInvent: no gradient or glow on primary (flat-first)
no repeated primary-filled treatment merely because several actions are clickable
no red-pill / green-pill mixed enums; compose semantic and shape axes instead
no Success or Warning Button semantics by default
no disabled attribute as a shortcut for loading semantics
intent: Trigger one immediate action while keeping action hierarchy, semantic intent, shape, size, and interaction state independently selectable.
interactionContract: Primary remains a scarce hierarchy signal: normally one highest-priority Primary action per view or action group.
Semantic intent is orthogonal to hierarchy. Destructive does not become a fourth hierarchy level; destructive Primary/Secondary/Tertiary all remain possible when composition requires them.
Destructive is reserved for destructive or irreversible actions and must be reinforced by explicit action copy and surrounding confirmation/context when risk is material.
Entering loading suppresses repeated activation until loading exits, but loading is not the disabled state.
Loading preserves the measured button width and height captured on entry so spinner insertion or label changes do not cause layout jump.
Pressed feedback is subordinate to loading; a loading button does not continue press/toggle activation.
accessibilityContract: Loading exposes busy semantics (for example aria-busy on Web or the platform equivalent) while remaining distinguishable from disabled.
Spinner + label keeps readable progress copy; spinner-only requires a persistent accessible name.
Destructive meaning is communicated by explicit action wording and context, never by danger color alone.
Pill shape does not reduce the platform touch target below the existing iOS 44 / Android 48 guidance.
